What your AI team actually does

Four domains where it creates capacity immediately.

🌿

Environmental & Planning

Species assessments, impact studies, compliance reports. AI drafts the structure, your ecologists judge the edge cases.

Example: An 8-person consultancy now delivers species assessments in half the time.
⚖

Legal & Compliance

Case research, filing prep, regulatory cross-checks. AI handles the lookup and formatting, your lawyers handle the argument.

Example: Instead of 2 days of case research — a structured brief the next morning.
🏥

Healthcare & Clinical

Patient documentation, protocol adherence, reporting. AI captures and structures, your clinicians decide and care.

Example: Clinical documentation completed in minutes — consistent and accurate.
📊

Finance & Analysis

Report generation, data synthesis, audit prep. AI assembles the picture, your analysts interpret it.

Example: Quarterly reports assembled overnight — your team reviews, not rewrites.
